experiences.problem: movie-factory-validation-report.json showed image_adapter_valid=false and video_adapter_valid=false -- the #1-ranked Development Priority item.

decision.decision_summary: Trace the validator's real adapter-resolution code path to find the actual root cause before attempting any fix.

action.action_summary: Wired 3 missing bundle_ref fields (image_adapter_ref, video_adapter_v2_ref, motion_adapter_ref) in titanic-standardized-dataset.json to 3 real, pre-existing, already-adapter_ready:true files -- purely additive, no new adapter content fabricated.

cause.root_cause_summary: A reference-wiring bug, not a missing capability -- the real adapter files already existed and were already valid; nothing pointed to them.

experiences.lesson: Before assuming new work is needed to unblock a goal, search for real, already-existing artifacts that satisfy the requirement -- the fix may be a missing reference, not missing content.

experiences.problem: cap_dataset_management held 72.6% of all LPM entities (a real, correctly-identified catch-all/taxonomy finding).

decision.decision_summary: Apply the catch-all finding directly to mark cap_dataset_management's own CAPABILITY-level functional_status as 'blocked'.

action.action_summary: Set overlay entry cap_dataset_management: blocked, evidence=concentration-rootcause-v1.json.

cause.root_cause_summary: A Goal-criterion-level finding (violates goal_semantic_quality's own "no catch-all" criterion) was over-applied to set a Capability-level functional judgment -- conflating two different kinds of claims.

experiences.problem: PHASE-945's new automatic Goal<->Capability contradiction detector found goal_repository_foundation (satisfied) backed by cap_dataset_management (blocked) -- a real, detected inconsistency.

decision.decision_summary: Re-check the original 'blocked' evidence against PHASE-943's fixed semantics (blocked requires hard_failure-category evidence) rather than force-correcting either side blindly.

action.action_summary: Re-read goal_model.json directly: confirmed "no catch-all capabilities" is goal_semantic_quality's own criterion, not goal_repository_foundation's. Corrected cap_dataset_management overlay: blocked -> pending.

evidence.evidence_detail: Population evidence real and complete; taxonomy concern real but does not show functional failure -- pending, not blocked.

cause.root_cause_summary: Same as exp_phase942's cause, now correctly attributed and fixed at the right layer (capability, not goal).

experiences.lesson: A Goal-level criterion violation does not automatically imply the underlying Capability is functionally broken -- always check whether evidence is being applied to the layer (Goal vs Capability) it actually supports before propagating a 'blocked' status.

experiences.problem: Is the GPU/ComfyUI server reachable yet? (Real, repeatable question -- not assumed answered by a prior negative result.)

decision.decision_summary: Re-run the exact same real, read-only connectivity check named in the chain's own verification_method; accept whatever the real result is.

evidence.evidence_detail: curl exit 7, Failed to connect to host.

cause.root_cause_summary: GPU/ComfyUI infrastructure genuinely unavailable in this environment -- not a PB judgment error.

experiences.lesson: A repeated real negative result is itself valuable evidence (confirms stability of the block, rules out transient failure) -- it should be recorded as its own experience, not discarded as "nothing happened".
